reason: Two reasons, the newer one sets the floor. (1) Migration 0042 made staff usernames unique per restaurant: API versions before b85b1855 find a staff member by username alone and key the failed-login lockout on the username, so once two shops share a username they would log the wrong account in, refuse a correct password, or lock one shop's staff out for another's mistakes. (2) From this commit, fee rates are stored as effective-dated versions in restaurants.settings.pnlRates ({versions:[...]}). Older API code cannot read that shape, so every day's payment fee and platform commission shows 0, and a single rates save from it replaces the whole history with the old flat shape, which newer code then applies to every past day. No data is exposed, but P&L figures change and rate history is lost. Roll back only to a version at or after this commit.
